evidence.text:
git add -A && git commit -m "codegen.ast: Make String argument-invariant by including 'text' in args

Previously, String used not_in_args=['text'] and relied on kwargs invariance (expr.func(**expr.kwargs()) == expr). For Basic subclasses, expr.func(*expr.args) == expr should hold. Remove not_in_args so 'text' is part of args, restoring positional arg invariance.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
